title: Minimum Deletions to Make Array Divisible
summary: Given arrays nums and numsDivide, determine the least deletions needed so the smallest element in nums divides all elements of numsDivide.
statement: Given arrays nums and numsDivide, determine the least deletions needed so the smallest element in nums divides all elements of numsDivide. If impossible, return -1. An integer x divides y if y % x == 0.
constraints: Delete any number of elements from nums.
After deletion, the smallest remaining nums value must divide every value in numsDivide.
Return the minimum deletions, or -1 if no nums value can satisfy the condition.
hints: A value divides every numsDivide entry exactly when it divides their gcd.
Compute that gcd once and sort nums.
Return the first sorted index whose value divides the gcd; earlier values are precisely the necessary deletions.
The first qualifying sorted value minimizes removed elements, and absence of one proves impossibility.
editorial: The first qualifying sorted value minimizes removed elements, and absence of one proves impossibility.

tests.explanation: After sorting, deleting both twos exposes three, which divides every target, so two deletions are needed.
No candidate divides the gcd two, so the result is minus one.
